=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text key "VIGENERECIPHER"
text msg "Beware the Jabberwock, my son! The jaws that bite, the claws that catch!"
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note clean keeps the letters of a, upper-cased, in r and returns how many
fn clean a view uchar * r edit uchar * to ulong
n = ulong 0
for i ulong len a
c = get a i
if and ge c 97 le c 122
c = sub c 32
end
if and ge c 65 le c 90
put r n c
n = add n 1
end
end
ret n
end
note vig adds (dir 0) or subtracts (dir 1) the key letters mod 26, the key repeating
fn vig a view uchar * r edit uchar * dir ulong to void
for i ulong len a
k = sub get key rem i len key 65
c = sub get a i 65
if eq dir 0
c = rem add c k 26
else
c = rem sub add c 26 k 26
end
put r i add c 65
end
end
fn main to int
t = new uchar 256 0
e = new uchar 256 0
d = new uchar 256 0
n = clean msg t
emit part t 0 n
emit nl
vig part t 0 n part e 0 n 0
emit part e 0 n
emit nl
vig part e 0 n part d 0 n 1
emit part d 0 n
emit nl
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
